claim.quote: We present a determination of the Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa matrix element |Vcb | from the decay B → Dℓνℓ using a 365 fb−1 e+ e− → Υ(4S) → B B̄ data sample recorded by the Belle II experiment at the SuperKEKB collider.

key_value_text.note: |Vcb| is a dimensionless CKM matrix element, so the value is given as formatted text with no unit.

name: Determination of |Vcb| using B→Dℓνℓ Decays at Belle II

summary.plain: Belle II measured how often a B meson (a particle containing a bottom quark) decays into a D meson plus a lepton and neutrino, and used that to determine |Vcb|, a fundamental parameter of the Standard Model that determines how often bottom quarks turn into charm quarks.
summary.technical: Inclusive-tag determination of |Vcb| from B⁰→D⁻(→K⁺π⁻π⁻) l⁺ νl and B⁺→D̄⁰(→K⁺π⁻) l⁺ νl decays in 365 fb⁻¹ of Belle II Υ(4S) data, using the recoil variable w=v_B.v_D and lattice-QCD form-factor averages. Reports B(B⁰→D⁻ l⁺ νl) = (2.06 ± 0.05stat ± 0.10sys)%, B(B⁺→D̄⁰ l⁺ νl) = (2.31 ± 0.04stat ± 0.09sys)%, a lepton-flavor-universality ratio B(B→D e νe)/B(B→D μ νμ) = 1.020 ± 0.020stat ± 0.022sys, and |Vcb| = (39.2 ± 0.4stat ± 0.6sys ± 0.5th)×10⁻³.

title: Determination of |Vcb| using B→Dℓνℓ Decays at Belle II
why_it_matters: The paper says |Vcb| determines the b → c transition rate and must be determined experimentally. Determinations from inclusive and from exclusive decays currently differ by about three standard deviations, which motivates further research; B → Dℓν has received less attention than B → D*ℓν, and the B → D transition has smaller theoretical uncertainties because it is described by a single vector form factor.
